1.1.q: According to the lecture, software is:
o: Only the executable code of a system
Only the source code and its test cases
The hardware together with its drivers
1.1.vi: Software = chương trình + tài liệu đi kèm (requirements, design models, user manuals).
1.1.en: Software = programs + associated documentation (requirements, design models, user manuals).

1.1.q: A product built to be sold to a range of different customers is:
1.1.vi: Generic: bán cho nhiều khách. Custom: một khách, theo spec của họ.
1.1.en: Generic: sold to many customers. Custom: one customer, to their spec.

1.1.q: Which is NOT one of the ways software can be created listed in the lecture?
1.1.vi: 3 cách: viết mới, cấu hình hệ thống generic, tái sử dụng phần mềm có sẵn.
1.1.en: Three ways: develop new programs, configure generic systems, reuse existing software.

1.1.q: Which attribute means software "must be understandable, usable and compatible with other systems"?
1.1.vi: Acceptability: được người dùng chấp nhận, dễ hiểu, dễ dùng, tương thích.
1.1.en: Acceptability: accepted by users; understandable, usable, compatible.

1.1.q: "Software should not make wasteful use of system resources" describes:
1.1.vi: Efficiency: không lãng phí tài nguyên hệ thống.
1.1.en: Efficiency: no wasteful use of system resources.

1.2.q: Boehm's 1981 chart shows that over time:
o: Software takes a growing share of total system cost
Hardware takes a growing share of total system cost
Software and hardware costs stay equal
1.2.vi: Từ 1955 đến 1985, phần chi phí cho phần mềm tăng, phần cứng giảm.
1.2.en: From 1955 to 1985 the software share grows and hardware shrinks.

1.2.q: For systems with a long life, maintenance costs:
o: May be several times development costs
Are always lower than development costs
1.2.vi: Hệ thống sống lâu: chi phí bảo trì có thể gấp nhiều lần chi phí phát triển.
1.2.en: Long-lived systems: maintenance may cost several times development.

1.2.q: Roughly what share of software engineering costs is testing?
For custom software, which costs often exceed development costs?
1.2.vi: Với custom software, chi phí evolution thường vượt chi phí phát triển.
1.2.en: For custom software, evolution costs often exceed development costs.

1.3.q: In the CHAOS Report 2020, what share of IT projects failed?
Which is one of the four goals of software engineering?
o: Writing the most lines of code
1.3.vi: 4 mục tiêu: cost effective, on time, high quality, satisfying customer's needs.
1.3.en: Goals: cost effective, on time, high quality, satisfying customer's needs.

1.3.q: Computer science is mainly concerned with:
o: The practicalities of delivering useful software
1.3.vi: CS: lý thuyết và nền tảng. SE: thực tiễn làm và giao phần mềm.
1.3.en: CS: theory and fundamentals. SE: practicalities of delivering software.

1.3.q: How does software engineering relate to system engineering?
o: SE is the part of system engineering concerned with developing software
System engineering is a part of SE
They are two names for the same discipline
1.3.vi: System engineering bao gồm hardware, software, process; SE là phần lo phần mềm.
1.3.en: System engineering covers hardware, software and process; SE is its software part.

1.4.q: "Applying AI to SE methods, practices and tools" is one direction of:
1.4.vi: Intelligent SE có 2 chiều: AI cho SE và SE cho hệ thống có AI.
1.4.en: Intelligent SE runs both ways: AI for SE, and SE for AI-enabled systems.

1.4.q: Wix, Shopify and Webflow are examples of:
1.4.vi: Low-code/no-code: tạo ứng dụng với rất ít code.
1.4.en: Low-code/no-code: create apps with minimal coding.

o: Automatically built, tested and prepared for release to production
Integrated by hand once per release
1.4.vi: CD: tự động build, test, chuẩn bị release. CI: tích hợp code tự động và thường xuyên.
1.4.en: CD: automatically built, tested, prepared for release. CI: frequent automatic integration.

1.4.q: An AI agent, as opposed to an assistant:
o: Receives a goal, plans steps, uses tools, observes results and iterates
Only completes the current line of code
Replaces the need for any testing
Is accountable for the system's ethics
1.4.vi: Agent tự lập kế hoạch và dùng công cụ; kỹ sư vẫn chịu trách nhiệm.
1.4.en: Agents plan and use tools; engineers remain accountable.

1.4.q: Which is listed as a risk of using AI agents in software engineering?
1.4.vi: Rủi ro: code trông đúng nhưng sai, lỗ hổng bảo mật, licence/IP, lộ dữ liệu mật.
1.4.en: Risks: plausible-but-wrong code, security flaws, licence/IP, data leaks.

o: Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery or Deployment
1.4.vi: CI = Continuous Integration (tích hợp code thay đổi tự động, thường xuyên) · CD = Continuous Delivery/Deployment.
1.4.en: CI = Continuous Integration (automatically and frequently integrating code changes) · CD = Continuous Delivery/Deployment.

1.4.vi: DevOps = Development + Operations: văn hoá, thực hành và công cụ giúp rút ngắn vòng đời phát triển.
1.4.en: DevOps = Development + Operations: culture, practices and tools that shorten the development lifecycle.

1.5.q: Which activity produces the software system itself?
1.5.vi: Specification: làm gì · Development: sản xuất · Validation: đúng ý khách · Evolution: thay đổi.
1.5.en: Specification: what · Development: produce · Validation: what customer wants · Evolution: change.

1.5.q: Changing the software in response to changing demands is:
1.5.vi: Evolution: thay đổi phần mềm theo nhu cầu mới.
1.5.en: Evolution: changing software for changing demands.

1.5.q: The data-flow perspective of a process model shows:
1.5.vi: Workflow: trình tự · Data-flow: luồng thông tin · Role/action: ai làm gì.
1.5.en: Workflow: sequence · Data-flow: information · Role/action: who does what.

1.5.q: Which is NOT a generic process model in lecture 01?
1.5.vi: Generic process models: Waterfall, Iterative development, Component-based SE.
1.5.en: Generic process models: Waterfall, Iterative development, Component-based SE.

1.5.vi: SDLC = Software Development Life Cycle, tên khác của software process.
1.5.en: SDLC = Software Development Life Cycle, another name for the software process.

1.6.q: Which statement about ethics matches the lecture?
o: Ethical behavior is more than simply upholding the law
Ethics only means obeying the law
Ethics is the client's concern, not the engineer's
Technical skill is the only responsibility
1.6.vi: Hành vi đạo đức không chỉ là tuân thủ pháp luật.
1.6.en: Ethical behavior is more than simply upholding the law.

1.6.q: Respecting the secrets of your employer or client is the issue of:
1.6.vi: Confidentiality: tôn trọng bí mật của chủ và khách.
1.6.en: Confidentiality: respect employers' and clients' secrets.

1.6.q: Using your technical skills to break into other people's computers violates:
1.6.vi: Computer misuse: không dùng kỹ năng để lạm dụng máy tính người khác.
1.6.en: Computer misuse: never misuse other people's computers.

1.6.q: "Software engineers shall be fair to and supportive of their colleagues" is the principle:
1.6.vi: COLLEAGUES: công bằng và hỗ trợ đồng nghiệp.
1.6.en: COLLEAGUES: fair to and supportive of colleagues.

1.6.q: Which principle says engineers shall act consistently with the public interest?
1.6.vi: PUBLIC: hành động vì lợi ích cộng đồng.
1.6.en: PUBLIC: act consistently with the public interest.
